lead.headline: Russian missiles land in Poland as Moscow pounds Kyiv in its biggest strike of the year
lead.summary: Two Russian missiles and a drone came down in Poland during a huge overnight attack on Ukraine — more than 110 missiles and 400 drones, at least 8 killed. NATO called it a 'grave violation'; Poland called it an intentional provocation.

sources: Open Chronicle global news brief, 20 Nov 2026

stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin sign joint peace declaration in Shenzhen
stories.summary: The first three-way meeting of the US, Chinese and Russian leaders produced a four-point declaration to cut nuclear risk and keep energy supplies steady — but Germany warned Europe would not accept a new Yalta.

stories.headline: UN court: Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
stories.summary: The International Court of Justice ruled the 2017 crackdown was genocide — the first such finding against a state. The judgment cannot be appealed.

stories.headline: Houthi missiles damage Riyadh tower as tanker burns in Hormuz
stories.summary: Houthi missiles hit Riyadh's financial district, damaging the sovereign wealth fund tower, while a tanker caught fire after hitting a mine near the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.headline: Global stocks slide as AI doubts deepen
stories.summary: The S&P 500 fell for a sixth straight day and Japan's Nikkei dropped 4.8%, with Anthropic's record debut failing to revive tech shares.

stories.headline: Cyclone Akvan makes landfall in Odisha
stories.summary: The storm came ashore on India's east coast after 80,000 people were moved to shelters.
